title: Show audit completion timestamp
summary: The Reports audit preview now displays the local completion date and time encoded in timestamped audit CSV filenames alongside the source path.
reason: Operators need to identify when the displayed audit completed without manually decoding the audit report filename.
behavior_before: The audit summary showed only the source CSV path, which required operators to decode the filename to determine the audit completion time.
behavior_after: Timestamped audit summary and priority CSV filenames render an Audit completed date-and-time field before the source path; older filenames without a timestamp remain readable without a fabricated time.
tests_added: Extended the Reports static test and browser Maintenance/Reports smoke fixture to require the audit completion field for timestamped reports.
manual_validation: git diff --check for all change-packet paths - passed.
